title: Ring glow in first person: replacements for the light rays
desc: Six ways for the ring to show it is charged in first person, with nothing on the arm, no panes or shafts near the camera, a small emissive area and saturated green: charge 0-100% (1-60), hold (60-90), Bridge used (90-120).

takes.name: face glow = charge
takes.facts: only the ring's face glows, steady; brightness = charge; nothing else; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: rim line
takes.facts: a thin solid light line traces round the gold rim as charge rises, full loop at 100%; face dim; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: orbit pixels
takes.facts: up to 4 small solid pixels circle slowly within 2 px of the ring face, one per 25% charge; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: face meter
takes.facts: the ring face is a 5-step meter, dark to lit from one edge; Bridge's cost drops a step; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: pulse on use
takes.facts: dark while charging and holding; using Bridge gives one quick pulse (face + rim, 90-96), then gone; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead

takes.name: knuckle light
takes.facts: a tiny point light over the back of the fist lights the knuckles only, no geometry, = charge; 1-60 charge 0->100%, 60-90 hold, 90-120 Bridge forms ahead
